paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Micro-F1 scores of MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor across a range of lambda values. The x-axis is labeled “λ value” and represents a linear scale from 0 to 3, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Micro-F1 Score (%)” and also employs a linear scale, ranging from approximately 53% to 58%, with tick intervals of 1%. The MatDetector (ours) line is displayed in magenta, and it begins at a score of approximately 53% at λ=0 and reaches a peak of approximately 57% at λ=1.5, trending downward to approximately 53% at λ=3. ChemDataExtractor is represented by a dark blue line, which initially begins at approximately 54% at λ=0 and decreases to approximately 49% at λ=1.5, before rising to approximately 52% at λ=3.
